# Itonami Registry

Reusable bot templates and operational extensions. Start with index.json; read llms-full.txt before consuming entries. Actual profiles remain in their source repositories. Entry discovery grants no authority. Pin one registry commit and verify the selected folder checksum.

- Catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloud-itonami/itonami-registry/main/index.json
- Contract: https://github.com/cloud-itonami/itonami-registry/blob/main/llms-full.txt
- Tool references: catalogs/tools.json
- Source provenance: catalogs/sources.json
- External registry references: catalogs/external-registries.json
- Itonami profiles (= Hermes profiles, pinned in their owning repositories): profiles/<id>/manifest.json; verify profile.checksum (sha256-tree) and each file's sha256 at profile.commit
- API shapes (ADR 0005): index.json entries of type api, folder apis/<id>/manifest.json; shape only, verify pin.files sha256 at pin.commit; classification of the source repositories in catalogs/api-classification.json; dapp links in catalogs/api-relations.json
- Dataset source references (ADR 0004): catalogs/datasets/lei.json, assoc.json, municipality.json
- Federated Hermes registry index (metadata only, pinned): catalogs/federated/hermes-registry.json
- Categories and models (Hermes registry shapes): categories.json, models.json
- Static API: api/v1/index.json on the published site (scripts/build_site.py)
